codeReview.summary: Implementation of GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/status endpoint is complete and correct. The handler correctly returns status (pending/running/completed/failed/cancelled) and progress (0-100) for all cases. Error field is included for failed tasks and cancelled_at for cancelled tasks. 404 and 400 error cases are properly handled. All 9 unit tests pass covering all VAL-API requirements.

summary: The status endpoint implementation is comprehensive and correctly handles all required scenarios: valid ID returns 200 with status/progress, pending shows progress=0, running shows progress 1-99, completed shows progress=100, failed includes error field, cancelled includes cancelled_at timestamp, not found returns 404, invalid UUID returns 400. All tests pass and code follows established project patterns.
